description:

She used to be somebody else, in another city, with another name â€” that person is officially dead, and Bahman Trujillo-Guerrero plans to keep it that way. She works as a street samurai out of Kessler Row, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

What Bahman Trujillo-Guerrero lacks in subtlety, she compensates for in thoroughness. No loose ends, no unfinished business, no second chances.

physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown with rich olive and amber undertones, cooled subtly by Eastern European ancestry. Sun-weathered in high-contact areas, maintaining even tone across the body despite six decades of hard use.
physical_description.complexion: Strong, angular features blending Latin American and Eastern European bone structure with South Asian softness â€” high, well-defined cheekbones with moderate width through the face, squared jawline with subtle roundness at the corners. Deep-set dark eyes. Minimal facial scarring. Skin shows the weathering of six decades and hard living, maintained with disciplined care. Thin lips, often pressed into a flat line.

The joints are seamlessly integrated but unmissable â€” no effort made to hide them. Faint seams along the forearms and shins suggest bone lacing beneath the skin. Subtle LED indicators glow amber at the elbow and knee joints when she moves under load.

No wasted gesture. When she walks, there is a barely perceptible hitch in the rhythm where the hydraulic joints compensate for impacts. She carries herself like someone who has already accounted for everything that could go wrong.
